name: tatr
description: Builds and installs the tatr task tracker from tsoding/tatr on Linux using apt-get, apk, dnf, microdnf, yum, tdnf, zypper or pacman.

tatrVersion.description: Git ref or commit to build from tsoding/tatr. Use a full commit SHA for a reproducible source revision.

installDependencies.description: Install the native C toolchain, libc headers, Git and CA certificates. Disable only on pre-provisioned images. Arch Linux performs a full upgrade to avoid partial upgrades.

runTests.description: Run upstream tests with nob -test before installing. The selected tatr revision must support this flag.
